publisher: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Waterworks
title: 料金自動計算（23区）— the Bureau's automatic charge calculator
url_note: Print-to-PDF supplied by the collector; the page's own article ID is 081-001-20240819-006200.
archive_note: Captured unrun. The form displays no figure until a bore, a volume and a number of months are entered, so the file is a form and not a result.
establishes: That the Bureau publishes an automatic calculator for the 23 wards, and that the page states its result does not apply to accounts under a reduction or under the shared-dwelling treatment — which is the same scope the tariff record carries.
does_not_establish: Any rate. A calculator is not the schedule under §7.1, and this capture is not even a calculator run: it is an empty form. It is archived because it was supplied and the record should show what was received, not only what was used.
